_note: Prairie Community Church's actual statement of faith. Adopting churches should replace with their own.

beliefs.title: The Bible
beliefs.statement: We believe the Bible is the inspired word of God and the final authority for how we live (2 Timothy 3:16-17).

beliefs.title: God
beliefs.statement: We believe in one God, eternally existing as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit (Matthew 28:19).

beliefs.title: Jesus
beliefs.statement: We believe Jesus is fully God and fully man, who died for our sins, rose from the dead, and will one day return (1 Corinthians 15:3-4).

beliefs.title: Salvation
beliefs.statement: We believe salvation comes through faith in Jesus alone, by God's grace — not by anything we earn (Ephesians 2:8-9).

beliefs.title: The Church
beliefs.statement: We believe the church is a family of people who love Jesus and each other, called to worship God and serve our neighbors (Acts 2:42-47).
